chunks.text:
[Intro]
{instrumental only, music box and harp play the melody softly, no vocals}
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Refrain]
Soft rain, falling slow,
river humming low.
Close your eyes, my love,
off to dreams you go.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
The frogs have said goodnight,
the boats are tied up tight,
the window wears the rain
like ribbons, soft and light.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Interlude]
{instrumental only, music box and harp play the refrain melody, no vocals}
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Verse 2]
The puddles hold the moon,
the crickets hum a tune,
the morning will be bright,
and I will see you soon.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront
